yesNoDecider.title: Yes or No
yesNoDecider.description: Decision helper! Ask a question and get a random answer

whatIs.title: What is Yes or No?
whatIs.description: A fun random answer tool for overcoming decision paralysis. Enter a question and get a Magic 8-ball style answer. Supports simple Yes/No to 7-level detailed responses with adjustable YES probability.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter your question (e.g., 'Should I exercise today?').
Adjust YES probability with the slider (default 50%).

tips.title: Tips
items: Best for light everyday decisions, not life-changing ones.
Detailed mode gives nuanced 7-level answers (Absolutely YES ~ Absolutely NO).
Check history for all your previous questions and answers.

items.a: No, each answer is randomly generated. The same question can get different answers each time.

items.q: Can I change the YES probability?
items.a: Yes, use the slider to set YES probability anywhere from 0% to 100%.
